reason: No proposal addresses installer lib purity. Lib files are mostly function definitions; a few (background-tasks.sh, packaging.sh, constants.sh) run conditionals or source helpers at top level.
No proposal concerns module headers. 28 of 61 lib/phase .sh files lack one or more of Purpose/Expects/Provides/Modder notes (20 have no header at all).
No proposal covers INSTALL_PHASE. install-core.sh sets INSTALL_PHASE immediately before sourcing every phase file.
No proposal concerns manifests. All 31 service directories contain manifest.yaml.
No proposal concerns core-service layout. No core service has compose.yaml, but dashboard and open-webui carry compose.local.yaml overlays.
No proposal concerns port binding. All published ports bind 127.0.0.1 or ${BIND_ADDRESS:-127.0.0.1}.
No proposal concerns shell strict mode. About 568 of ~637 executable bash scripts set -euo pipefail; exceptions are mainly container entrypoints and library start scripts.
No proposal concerns shell portability. GNU-only grep -P appears in ~14 places (Linux-only amd-topo.sh); date %N is wrapped by portable helpers.

The auth-wrapper proposals presuppose HTTP handlers but do not require FastAPI. Most Python API services use FastAPI; a few (pixel-edge, remote-provider-ssh-tunnel, pixel-agent host previews) use http.server/aiohttp.
D-c72ce2 is about test-file existence, not the framework. Most tests are pytest; about 259 of 858 Python test files use unittest.TestCase.
No proposal concerns styling. Tailwind utility classes dominate, but 38 component CSS files (~3,150 lines) and custom class names are also used.
D-80b356 concerns JS bare Error throws, not Python catches. About 419 broad except clauses in 127 non-test Python files, with silent pass/return None after excepts common.
No proposal forbids retries. Dozens of retry loops exist (for attempt in range(...), with_retries, shell seq loops) though most files have none.
No proposal forbids fallback chains. Fallback patterns are pervasive (e.g. sed -i || sed -i '', ~290 'fallback' references in Python/shell).
No proposal concerns exception specificity. Of ~3,870 except clauses, ~419 are broad; the majority name specific types.
No proposal concerns internal try/except. ~4,000 try blocks across 412 of 527 non-test Python files, many in internal helpers.
No proposal concerns trap. Traps are mostly EXIT cleanup; only ~3 scripts use an ERR trap for error context.
No proposal concerns tolerated failures. '|| warn' appears 9 times versus ~809 '|| true'.
No proposal concerns '|| true'/'2>/dev/null'. ~809 '|| true' and ~1,470 '2>/dev/null' with very few explanatory comments on the same line.
D-6e9535/D-4c758e require auth dependencies, not HTTPException error signalling. 31 of 37 routers raise HTTPException; a few read-only routers have none.
No proposal concerns None-as-error. About 135 except blocks return None directly, a notable minority.
No proposal concerns test exception handling. Test excepts mostly assert on or skip for environment limits; some swallow (e.g. except OSError: pass).
No proposal concerns size limits. Many files exceed 500 lines by far (ods-host-agent.py >18k lines, pixel_ingress.mjs >2k).
No proposal covers the pure-core/imperative-shell split. Phases do the I/O; lib files are mostly functions with a few top-level side effects.

D-6e9535/D-4c758e require a specific auth dependency on handlers, not the general rule of injecting dependencies via Depends()/env vars. Routers use Depends() widely (~174 uses); bash scripts take config via env vars.
Same as R02: no proposal; lib files are largely pure with a few top-level side effects.
No proposal concerns ports. All ports bind 127.0.0.1; APE_PORT and BRAVE_SEARCH_PORT are absent from ports.json.
No proposal concerns manifest schema. All 31 service manifests validate against service-manifest.v1.json.
No proposal concerns broad catches or strict mode. Strict mode is mostly present, but broad/silent catches and '|| true' swallowing are widespread.
D-c72ce2 asks for a test file per source file, not that tests are CI-wired. Verifying wiring would require executing repository code (list-unwired-tests.py), which is not allowed.
Return-type proposals (D-637b72, D-f40096, D-2264ef) do not state the mypy-baseline ratchet. Checking needs mypy with locked deps installed.
No proposal concerns license retention. Vendored code keeps its license and provenance notices.
No proposal concerns _sed_i/_now_ms. Helpers are used in ~36 places, but ~63 raw 'sed -i' remain (many in Linux containers or with BSD fallbacks).
No proposal concerns associative arrays. Several production scripts guard with BASH_VERSINFO, but some (11-services.sh, memory-shepherd) use declare -A without a guard.
No proposal concerns path helpers. Only ~5 shell files use path-utils.sh, while ~85 call realpath/readlink -f directly.
No proposal concerns undefined references. ruff F (undefined names) passes and bash -n passes; exec-form expansion was not exhaustively verified.
No proposal concerns skips. Sampled skips (~370 total) are environment guards (symlink privileges), not missing features.
No proposal concerns strict mode. Where present, set -euo pipefail is near the top (561 of 567 within 30 lines); ~69 bash scripts lack it.
No proposal concerns quoting. Quoting is the norm in sampled files, but unquoted expansions still appear on a large number of lines.
Same as R02: no proposal; a few lib files have top-level conditionals/sourcing.
No proposal concerns phase execution. Every phase file runs its logic at top level when sourced.
No proposal concerns installer UI. clear, bell and cursor escapes are all gated behind the cinematic-mode check.
No proposal concerns headers. 20 of 61 lib/phase files lack the 'ODS Installer' header block, and others miss fields.
No proposal concerns phase numbering. Phases are numbered and sourced in order; 02b deviates from NN-name and lacks the header.
No proposal concerns OpenCode keys. 07-devtools uses LITELLM_KEY on gateway branches and 'no-key' on the direct llama-server path.
No proposal concerns LiteLLM config. Writers set enable_thinking: false and use os.environ/LLAMA_SERVER_API_KEY, but env-generator.ps1 writes a literal key on non-AMD paths.
Same as R02: no proposal; mostly functions and constants.
No proposal concerns UI output modes. Clear/bell/cursor motion are gated on cinematic checks across Linux, macOS and Windows UI helpers.
No proposal concerns SELinux labels. 54 of 72 bind mounts carry :z; most unlabelled ones are device/sysfs mounts.
No proposal concerns manifests. Every manifest sets schema_version: ods.services.v1.
No proposal concerns manifests. All define id/name/port/health except tailscale, which lacks health.
No proposal concerns manifests. All 16 feature entries define the required fields.
No proposal concerns llm blocks. Seven consumer services declare service.llm; complete coverage of all consumers was not confirmed.
No proposal concerns the shared block. The two 456-line blocks are byte-identical (same md5).
No proposal concerns extension file size/encoding. ~455 source/text files contain non-ASCII and 38 files exceed 100 KB.
No proposal concerns .env loading. load_env_file is used in ~27 scripts; a few still source .env directly.
No proposal concerns gateway alias. Many apps use ods/current and litellm:4000, but ~11 compose/manifests target llama-server:8080 directly.
No proposal concerns model-name persistence. No GGUF filenames in extension config; model settings use ods/current or env.
No proposal concerns direct routes. Both route: direct manifests declare pinning: none rather than dynamic (with switchboard exemptions).
No proposal concerns depends_on. All depends_on targets are defined somewhere; hermes-proxy depends on hermes from another extension.
No proposal concerns ports. Host ports use ${X_PORT:-default} env vars; APE and Brave Search vars are missing from ports.json.
No proposal concerns overlays. Overlays mostly change devices, images and runtime command flags.
No proposal concerns service-to-service URLs. Sampled config uses container DNS names with internal ports.
No proposal concerns port defaults. ports.json covers most services; APE_PORT and BRAVE_SEARCH_PORT are absent.
No proposal concerns unused variables. Checking needs ESLint, which cannot be run here.
No proposal concerns pycodestyle. ruff check --select E,F,W with CI ignores passes on ods/.
No proposal concerns Pyflakes. ruff F rules pass on ods/.
No proposal concerns pycodestyle warnings. ruff W rules pass on ods/.
No proposal concerns Python 3.9 syntax. ruff --target-version py39 --select E9 passes.
Return-type proposals encourage annotations but do not state that mypy checks untyped defs. Checking needs mypy with service deps installed.
No proposal concerns ShellCheck. ShellCheck is not available here.
No proposal concerns curl targets. There are no curl http://localhost: calls outside the excluded files; 127.0.0.1 is used throughout.
No proposal concerns ShellCheck warnings. ShellCheck is not available here.
No proposal concerns syntax checks. bash -n passes for all 664 .sh files outside vendor/pixel.
No proposal concerns PowerShell. No ConvertTo-SecureString calls in any of 118 .ps1 files.
No proposal concerns release pins. Whether edits went only through RELEASE-MANIFEST.json can't be told without history or running the generator check.
No proposal concerns ruff/py_compile. ruff E/F/W and E9 checks pass on ods/.
D-80b356 concerns throwing Errors, not adding defensive handling. Existing code is full of error handling, fallbacks and defensive checks.
No proposal concerns try/except. ~4,000 try blocks in 412 of 527 non-test Python files.
D-c72ce2 only covers dashboard-api Python tests. BATS tests are named after libs, though ~18 of 32 don't match an installers lib/phase basename.
D-c72ce2 requires a test file per dashboard-api file but not the test_<router>.py naming, so NONE. Most routers have tests/test_<router>.py; auth, pixel_images and pixel_teams don't.
No proposal concerns try/except in tests. 324 of 858 Python test files contain try blocks.
No proposal concerns private-function calls in tests. ~253 Python test files call module._private functions.
No proposal concerns sleep. ~220 of ~1,870 test files use sleep.
No proposal concerns test suppression. ~122 of ~1,870 test files use '|| true'.
No proposal concerns test frameworks. Only ~5 test files define Base/Mixin classes.
No proposal concerns parametrize. Parametrize is heavily used (~1,950); sampled cases include several two-case parametrizations.
No proposal concerns Pydantic mocking. No patching of model_validate/ValidationError/BaseModel found in tests.
No proposal concerns shell-test suppression. 130 of 472 shell/BATS test files use 2>/dev/null.
